text: At an abandoned water filtration plant, a low-budget crew shooting the zombie film True Fear watch [their cameraman turn and bite|threat|the dead that rise] after the director Higurashi, desperate for success, has [a blood pentagram painted|origin|deliberately called up] to wake the plant's haunted past. He keeps the camera rolling as the cast flee and fight, and then the story steps back to show [a live television broadcast shot in a single take|images|pictures, screens and recordings], where a harried director and his family hold the chaos together.
